event: Gold closes for the weekend around midnight SAST tonight and reopens Monday around 01:00 SAST. Next week's high-impact data times are UNVERIFIED, so check the calendar before trading.

bullets.title: Weak weekly close
bullets.text: Gold is about 3,873 at 23:35 SAST, roughly flat to slightly down on the day, after the post-PPI spike to about 3,923 faded (xauad, Kitco).

bullets.title: Worst week since June
bullets.text: Rallies.ai reports gold down about 4.5% this week, its steepest weekly drop since early June, after Thursday's 13-month low of 3,852.

bullets.title: Day range
bullets.text: Today's range was about 3,866 to 3,924 (Kitco 3,867.40 to 3,924.00; xauad 3,865.72 to 3,923.14).

bullets.title: Yields and dollar
bullets.text: Trading Economics shows US yields near 5.15% (tenor UNVERIFIED, likely the 10-year) and the dollar index near 103.4, both a weight on gold.

bullets.title: December hike priced
bullets.text: Futures price roughly 85-91% odds of a quarter-point December hike after PPI; the sources disagree, so the exact figure is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: PPI was tame
bullets.text: October PPI rose 0.3%, below the 0.4% forecast, but that did not cool hike bets for long (Rallies.ai, Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Weekend gap risk
bullets.text: Trump said the US no longer needs an Iran deal and Brent is near 96 dollars, so weekend headlines can gap gold at Monday's open.

buy.title: Buy plan: hold at 3,852-3,856 (counter-trend)

keys.label: Buy zone
keys.value: 3,852-3,856, only after a dip that holds

look: This is counter-trend. The bias is down, so use half size or skip it.
Price dipping to the 3,852 low and a 15M close back up out of the zone.
A 1H higher low inside the zone, not a fast slice through it.
Wait for Monday's first hour to settle. Do not buy the opening gap.
Take some profit at 3,867 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying just because price looks cheap. The week fell about 4.5% and yields are above 5%.
A Monday gap below 3,852 can skip your entry and your stop.
Thin liquidity in the first hours of Monday's Asia session can spike through 3,852.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rejection at 3,903

keys.label: Sell zone
keys.value: Rejection at 3,900-3,906, where the PPI spike stalled

look: Price bouncing back up to 3,900-3,906 and stalling there again.
A clear 15M rejection wick or bearish close near 3,903.
Yields staying above 5% and the dollar above 103.
Take some profit at 3,867 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Selling in the middle at 3,873, right on top of 3,865-3,867 support. Wait for the retest of 3,903.
Iran and oil headlines over the weekend can lift gold fast, so a 1H close above 3,926 can run to 3,934-3,940.
Chasing a Monday gap down. If price opens far below 3,865, wait for a retest instead.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
